feedback.text: Exam paas hai aur aadha syllabus baaki hai. Please isko improve kijiye.
Bahut strict hain, koi baat karne se darta hai.
Not good.
Doubt poocho to bas 'book padh lo' bol diya jaata hai.
Marking bilkul fair hai, copies bhi dikhayi jaati hain. Lekin kuch bhi clear nahi hota, bas board pe likh ke chhod diya jaata hai.
Many classes were cancelled without any notice. Very strict and not approachable at all.
Easy to talk to about anything, even career advice. Thank you Sir!
Lectures are rushed. Please slow down, half the class is lost. Hope this improves next semester.
Neither too strict nor too friendly. Marking is a bit strict but okay.
Very strict and not approachable at all.

Baat kar sakte hain par cabin mein milna mushkil hai.
Not good.
Class bahut rush hoti hai, ek topic khatam nahi hota aur doosra shuru.
Ma'am bahut fast padhati hain, kuch samajh nahi aata. Doubts kabhi clear nahi hote, poochne mein bhi darr lagta hai.

Notes bahut acche hain, exam ke liye kaafi hain. Lekin bina bataye class cancel ho jaati hai, bahut problem hoti hai.
Doubts kabhi clear nahi hote, poochne mein bhi darr lagta hai.
Explanations are confusing and jump between topics. Lectures are rushed. Please slow down, half the class is lost. Please look into this.

Doubts are answered, but there is rarely time for them. Marking is a bit strict but okay.
Syllabus time se pehle khatam ho gaya, revision bhi hua. Padhane ki speed perfect hai, notes banane ka time mil jata hai.
Every unit is covered properly with revision at the end. Keep it up.
Mid-sem paper lamba tha, baaki theek.
Mid-sem paper lamba tha, baaki theek.

Evaluation is fair and answer sheets are shown to us.
Saare units properly cover hue, exam ki tension nahi. Padhane ki speed perfect hai, notes banane ka time mil jata hai.
Marking is transparent and the mid-sem papers are fair. Notes and slides shared are excellent for exam prep. Thank you Sir!
Clarity is average, most of it makes sense after revising.
The whole syllabus was covered well before the exams.
Padhane ki speed perfect hai, notes banane ka time mil jata hai. Lekin concepts bilkul samajh nahi aate, explanation bahut confusing hai.
